metadata.question: Does location (33.97811334086217, -118.2436826460509) at Los Angeles have a higher average nitrogen dioxide concentration than location (32.7358717958782,-117.15380986802357) San Diego from 2018 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data for nitrogen dioxide concentration. The collection is 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' with band 'NO2_column_number_density'. Time range: 2018-01-01 to 2020-01-01 (covers 2018-2019). 2. Masking strategy: The NO2 data is already processed and quality controlled, so minimal masking needed. We'll use the built-in quality flag if available. 3. Logic: Calculate mean NO2 concentration for each location over the time period, then compare. Need to check for empty collections and valid pixels. Important considerations: - Sentinel-5P launched in 2017, so should have data for 2018-2019 - Need to handle two separate points and compare their values - Must check collection sizes and valid pixel counts ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the two locations const laPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2436826460509, 33.97811334086217]); const sdPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.15380986802357, 32.7358717958782]); // Time period: 2018-2019 const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2020-01-01'; // Get Sentinel-5P NO2 data const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection size const collectionSize = no2Collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total NO2 images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for the entire period const meanNo2 = no2Collection.mean(); // Extract values at both points const laValue = meanNo2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laPoint, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density'); const sdValue = meanNo2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: sdPoint, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density'); // Get values and check for validity const laNo2 = laValue.getInfo(); const sdNo2 = sdValue.getInfo(); console.log(`LA NO2: ${laNo2 !== null ? laNo2.toFixed(6) : 'null'}`); console.log(`SD NO2: ${sdNo2 !== null ? sdNo2.toFixed(6) : 'null'}`); // Check for invalid data if (laNo2 === null || sdNo2 === null || isNaN(laNo2) || isNaN(sdNo2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if values are reasonable (NO2 should be positive and typically < 0.001 mol/m²) if (laNo2 < 0 || laNo2 > 0.01 || sdNo2 < 0 || sdNo2 > 0.01) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare values and output result if (laNo2 > sdNo2) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
